rules.rule: Rulebook and reference config change only through web:review
must: Change any of them only through\s+`web:review`
never hand-edit them
adding or changing a rule belongs to\s+web:review

rules.rule: Production applies to .vue/.ts, Test to tests; Test inherits Production
must: apply Production to `\*\.vue` and `\*\.ts`, and Test to `\*\.test\.ts`
Test inherits Production unless a Test rule overrides\s+it
before editing a test, an e2e spec, or test support \(`src/testing\.ts`,\s+benchmarks\), read `references/test\.md` and `references/production\.md`\s+both

rules.rule: Mechanical rules live in the reference Biome config; the project config may add, never drop
must: Mechanical rules live in \[references/biome\.json\]

rules.rule: A project's biome.json keeps every reference rule, may add, never drops
must: it may add rules,\s+never drop one

rules.rule: Every response is checked into app types at the client boundary; no unchecked as T
must: never `as T` an unchecked body
pages and stores never\s+call `fetch`

rules.rule: Navigate by route name, never a string path
must: navigate with `\{ name, params, query \}`,\s+never a string path

rules.rule: Async read state goes through the one shared read helper
must: in the project's one shared read\s+helper, never in\s+hand-rolled refs per page

rules.rule: TSDoc summaries start with a verb or noun phrase, never the symbol's name
must: never with the symbol's own name
no `@param` or `@returns`

rules.rule: Tests fake fetch with METHOD /path keys and never mock own modules
must: keyed `"METHOD /path"` that\s+throw on any request not listed; never mock your own modules

rules.rule: Fixing runs bun run check before and after; never commits
must: Run `bun run check` in the root
the job is\s+not done until it passes
Never `git commit`

rules.rule: plan_first proposes the budget and stops before checking
must: propose the budget and the directory list, then stop for\s+the user's answer, checking nothing until it comes

rules.rule: Tokens read in any order; an unrecognized token is named and ignored, an unresolvable target asks
must: Read the tokens in any order: a reserved word is a mode or flag, `key=value` is a control, and anything else is the target
say it was not recognized, name the ones that exist, and run with the defaults as if it were absent
A target that resolves to nothing: say so and ask — never guess what to work on

rules.rule: A FILE:LINE target checks the unit enclosing that line
must: `FILE:LINE` \(`src/pages/DevicesPage\.vue:42`\) — the unit enclosing that line

rules.rule: lineWidth key: javascript for .ts and <script> (no typescript key), html in <template>, css in <style>
must: `javascript` for `\.ts` and inside `<script>` \(Biome has no\s+`typescript` key\), `html` inside `<template>`, `css` inside `<style>`

rules.rule: A delegated run given a pinned rule-id and severity list uses it as a Scale worker does
must: A pinned rule-id and severity list in the invocation is used as a Scale\s+worker uses the parent's

rules.rule: The header prints each width in play per language, one number when they agree
must: each width in play by language \(`width 100 javascript, 120 html \(from\s+biome\.json\)`\), one number when they agree

rules.rule: fix skips the pick step even after a plan answer
must: the pick step still runs unless `fix`
